CVE-2026-63436.title: zt-zip: Path traversal in fluent API unpack
CVE-2026-63436.description: zt-zip is a Java library that provides convenience methods for ZIP archive manipulation. A crafted entry containing parent-directory traversal can therefore write outside outputDir through both the normal copy branch and the ZipEntryTransformer branch. CVE-2026-99301.title: virtio_net: atomically disable rx mode work
CVE-2026-99301.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

virtio_net: atomically disable rx mode work

virtio-net uses a boolean to gate rx_mode_work during device teardown.
The flag is changed under RTNL, but ndo_set_rx_mode checks it under the
address-list lock. A callback can therefore pass the check and enqueue work
